audit.whatIsWrong: The 2+ items row reads Urgot in both layers, but the already-audited mirror set that row to 'Skill'.
audit.why: The mirror (garen__urgot) explicitly proposes the last row as Skill and keeps rows 0-5 as Urgot, because Urgot's ranged poke and shred genuinely own levels 1-6 against a melee whose only gap-closer is a 300-range Decisive Strike, while Courage plus a true-damage execute levels the late duel. Both layers are flipped together so the page cannot render two answers.
audit.corrected: Row 6 set to Skill in phases[6].side and win[6], rating rescaled to 5/10, and the accompanying prose softened to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: sequencingCues is 0 — the page names Decisive Strike constantly but never gives a number.
audit.why: Decisive Strike is a flat 8s at every rank, Courage is 22/19.5/17/14.5/12s, Judgment 9/8.25/7.5/6.75/6s, Demacian Justice 120/100/80s. Yours: Purge 12s down to no cooldown and no cost at rank 5, Disdain 16s at rank 1, Corrosive Charge 10s at 800 range, Fear Beyond Death 100/85/70s.
audit.corrected: Decisive Strike's 8s and Courage's 22s rank-1 cooldown now anchor the commit advice.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page repeatedly says to Q-slow him before Decisive Strike, which the ability text directly contradicts, and never mentions Courage's shield or Demacian Justice's true damage.
audit.why: Riot's text: Decisive Strike 'gains a burst of Move Speed, breaking free of all slows affecting him' — slowing him first is exactly what it undoes. Courage grants a shield and tenacity followed by longer damage reduction, so burst dumped into a fresh Courage is refunded. Demacian Justice deals true damage, so armour is the wrong answer to his execute.
audit.corrected: dosFull[0].d and report[5].t rewritten around forcing Courage out and committing in Decisive Strike's 8s downtime; spikes[3] states the true damage.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns lists Decisive Strike twice and gives no durations.
audit.why: The two cooldowns that matter are Decisive Strike at 8s and Courage at 22s rank 1; the second entry duplicated the first.
audit.corrected: Replaced with one Decisive Strike line and one Courage line, both with real numbers.

edits.before: Sterak's + Cleaver makes your W-trades unloseable head-on. Garen must dodge E forever or find a jungler — punish the first mistake with R.
edits.after: Sterak's + Cleaver keeps your head-on trades strong, but Courage and a true-damage execute even the duel out — punish only clean mistakes with R.

edits.before: At 2+ items your percent-HP shred and execute beat his tank stacking.
edits.after: At 2+ items your shred still bites, but Courage and his true-damage R even it.

edits.before: Out-range his short trades — shotgun-poke and kite his spin. Urgot wins by trading around Garen's Decisive Strike (Silence) and cashing the pattern: out-range and kite his spin down.
edits.after: Decisive Strike is 8s, breaks every slow you apply and silences you mid-Purge — poke from beyond its 300 range and make him spend Courage, 22s at rank 1, before you commit.

edits.before: - Garen Decisive Strike (Silence): matchup-defining — His gap-close + silence. Q-slow him before it. Track it before every engage. - Garen Decisive Strike: Cleanses slows, gains move speed; next auto silences and deals bonus damage. Dodge or sidestep it.
edits.after: - Decisive Strike: flat 8s. It breaks every slow you apply and silences you on the next hit, so hold Purge until after he swings it. - Courage: 22/19.5/17/14.5/12s of shield, tenacity and damage reduction — burst into a fresh one is refunded, so force it out first.

edits.before: His gap-close + silence. Q-slow him before it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Decisive Strike breaks your slows, so Q-first does nothing — commit in its 8s downtime.

edits.before: Track Garen's Decisive Strike (Silence): His gap-close + silence. Q-slow him before it. When it is down — W-shred him.
edits.after: Courage gives a shield and tenacity on a 22s rank-1 cooldown — force it out first, then W-shred him through the downtime.

edits.before: You hold the edge into 2+ items: your percent-HP shred and R execute punish his health/armor stacking, and he can't burst you through Purge before you melt him.
edits.after: You hold an edge into 2+ items, but Demacian Justice is true damage so armour never saves you — stay above its threshold and keep shredding his health stacking.
